title: 功能词（上）：冠词、介词、代词
goal: 能根据前后的语法关系补全 the、of、in、their 等功能词。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 阅读

points.label: 介词：由前面的动词、形容词或后面的时间地点决定
代词：确定所指对象及其单复数

body.p: 补全单词每段 10 个空，每隔一个词挖一个。所以 the、of、in、their 这类功能词一定会出现。本课程九段样题的 90 个空中，功能词占 48 个。
功能词很短，只给出一两个字母，同一个开头有好几个候选词。判断靠语法：后面是不是名词，前面的动词搭配哪个介词，所指的是单数还是复数。
本课讲三类：冠词和限定词、介词、代词。连词、助动词、that 与 than 见下一课。

cards.title: 已给字母与候选词
cards.intro: 已给字母和所缺字母数相同的功能词只有几个。
rows: that　this　they　them　then　than

cards.title: 冠词和限定词
rows: 后面是单数名词，第一次提到
An island forms when a volcano rises above the sea.
后面的名词前面提过，或者世上只有一个
The island grows as more lava cools.　the sun
名词后面有 of 短语
the surface of the earth　the number of species
the largest　the first　the same
后面是复数名词，指刚说的那几样
后面是单数名词，指刚说的那件事
cards.note: 单数可数名词前必须有限定词。遇到「空 + 单数名词」，候选为 a、an、the、this、its、their。

cards.title: 介词
cards.intro: 介词多由它前面或后面的词决定。
rows: depend on　result in　lead to　consist of　differ from　belong to　deal with
similar to　different from　rich in　responsible for　capable of
the cause of　an increase in　a reason for　the effect on　access to
in 1850　in the nineteenth century　at night　during the war　for centuries　by 1900
in the ocean　on the surface　at the edge　from A to B　into the soil
cut with stone tools　travel by sea

cards.title: 代词
rows: 指前面一个单数的东西
The tree loses its leaves, and it stops growing.
指前面的复数，或者一群人
Birds build their nests where predators cannot reach them.
This explains why the lake is salty.
逗号或介词后面，补充说明前面的名词
a gas which traps heat　the way in which bees communicate
后面跟名词；或者 each of、one … the other
cards.note: 先找到所指的名词，看它是单数还是复数。所指是 The tree 时，用 its，不用 their。

body.p: th- 开头的空数量最多。先看所缺字母数，再看后面的成分。

list: 缺两个，后面是完整的句子（有主语有动词）：that。Scientists found th__ the ice was melting.
缺两个，后面直接是动词：they。Th__ live in groups.
缺两个，在动词或介词后面：them。Farmers stored the seeds and planted th__ in spring.
缺两个，后面是单数名词：this 或 that。th__ method
缺两个，前面是比较级：than。larger th__ the moon
缺三个，后面是名词，意思是「它们的」：their。th___ wings
缺三个，后面是复数名词，意思是「这些」：these 或 those。th___ rocks
缺三个，后面是 is、are、was、were：there。Th___ are two reasons.

body.p: this 与 that、these 与 those 有时都能成立。指上文刚提到的内容时，用 this、these。

cards.title: 练习一　冠词和限定词

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: Coral reefs are built by tiny animals. When a coral animal dies, t{he} hard shell around its body remains, and a{n} entirely new layer grows on top of it. Over thousands of years, th{ese} layers form a{n} enormous structure. Th{is} process is slow, but t{he} result is impressive: t{he} largest reef in t{he} world can be seen from space.
notes: the：后面有 around its body 限定，说的就是那一个壳。
an：后面的 entirely 是元音开头。
these：后面是复数 layers，指刚说的那些层。
an：enormous 是元音开头；structure 是单数，第一次提到。
this：后面是单数 process，指刚说的整件事。
the：result 指的是这个过程的结果，只有一个。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: The Nile flows fr{om} the highlands o{f} East Africa t{o} the Mediterranean Sea. For thousands o{f} years, farmers depended o{n} its yearly floods. The water spread over the fields i{n} late summer and left behind a layer of rich soil. Crops were planted i{n} the autumn and harvested b{y} hand i{n} the spring. Grain was then carried b{y} boat to the cities.

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: Ants live in large groups, and ea{ch} ant has a job. Some workers leave the nest to find food, and when th{ey} find it, th{ey} carry i{t} back to th{eir} nest. On the way, th{ey} leave a chemical trail behind th{em}. Ot{her} ants follow th{is} trail, wh{ich} becomes stronger as more ants use i{t}.
notes: they：指 workers，后面直接是动词 find。
their：后面是名词 nest，指 workers 的。
this：后面是单数 trail，指刚说的那条。
which：逗号后面，补充说明 trail。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: Glaciers are huge masses o{f} ice that move slowly over t{he} land. Th{ey} form i{n} cold regions where snow does not melt during summer. Over many years, t{he} weight o{f} new snow turns t{he} lower layers into ice. As a glacier moves, i{t} carries rocks wi{th} it and cuts deep valleys in the ground. Th{ese} valleys remain long after the ice has gone.

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: Bees and flowers depend o{n} each other. A bee visits a flower to collect food f{or} its hive. While i{t} feeds, grains o{f} pollen stick t{o} its body. T{he} bee then carries th{em} to a{n} open flower o{f} the same kind. Without th{is} help, many plants could not produce seeds.
